paragraphs.text: Matt Tabak is a senior Magic editor, the former Magic rules manager , and a member of Magic R&D .

Matt Tabak started working for Wizards of the Coast prior to 2011, originally beginning his career with the company in Customer Service. He then transferred to R&D as a card editor, and eventually became the second-longest-serving Rules Manager after his predecessor Mark Gottlieb from 2012 to 2016, and again from 2020 to 2021. In April 2016, Eli Shiffrin took over the responsibilities of the rules manager. According to Eli's LinkedIn, he stopped working for Wizards of the Coast as of August 2020, with Matt Tabak taking up the role of rules manager once again until Jess Dunks took office in February 2021. Matt still regularly writes the usual "Mechanics" article for new sets.

Because of his activities outside of editing (e.g., MagicCon event design, new player experience writing), Matt's official title was changed from Principal Editor to Principal GX (Game Experience) Designer in June 2026.
